content:
vivian: Kickoff for co-hosted hands-on with StratusOne + HelioSystems on Nov 9. Main asks: speaker roster, QR-pod contactless swag, and a compact demo fallback ladder. Can owners take action?
omar: I can run speaker confirmations and collect short bios. Can we lock names by Tue EOD?
claire: Marketing here. Need headshots + 1-line blurbs and pronouns by Thu. Also want a micro-CTA on the landing page for the hands-on lab.
hugo: Ops will own demo image + QR-pod flow. Primary demo on HelioSystems sandbox (GPU). Fallback 1 = local CPU container (boots <45s). Fallback 2 = 90s screen-recorded walkthrough + Q&A. I'll also prepare an offline web fallback served from a USB key.
vivian: For swag, vendor demoed a "QR-pod" (small contactless locker with one-time code). Proposal: generate single-use claim codes tied to reg ID; QR at pod redeems and releases package. Limit one per registration. Thoughts?
omar: Works for me. Add a tiny promo card inside with a short signup QR so we can measure post-event conversion. Also please cap at 1 per reg to avoid hoarding.
claire: Volunteer plan: 12:30-13:30 lead @hugo, 13:30-14:15 backup @vivian. Can StratusOne provide an on-site engineer for the first 20m?
hugo: StratusOne confirmed Leah as overflow. I'll ship swag to vendor warehouse Nov 6. If QR-pod capacity is insufficient, plan B is a staffed table with a contactless scanner.
ops-bot: calendar: "StratusOne + HelioSystems Hands-on Lab" Nov 9 13:00-14:00 PT. Dry run Nov 7 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
vivian: Demo fallback script: 1) try HelioSystems sandbox 2) if latency/errors after 45s, announce "switching to local" and load local container 3) if still failing, play 90s clip and pivot to Q&A. Keep language concise and calm.
hugo: Packing manifest draft: 
```
- 140 sticker sleeves
- 50 USB-C demo dongles (preloaded)
- 30 pocket dev kits (boxed)
- 150 one-page quickstarts
```
I'll add weights/dims and courier labels by tomorrow and post photos of packed crates.
omar: For the QR-pod flow: we generate per-reg single-use codes, export CSV to vendor, vendor preloads pods. Vendor app scans QR -> releases. Hugo, can you test end-to-end in dry run?
hugo: Yep. I'll bring a spare phone + mini router and test sequence during dry run. Also bringing 2x HDMI adapters, spare ethernet cable, small switch, and a NUC with the container preloaded.
claire: Promo schedule: Nov 1 initial, Nov 5 reminder, Nov 8 last call. Avoid public latency/cost numbers unless legal signs off. Use qualitative phrasing.
vivian: AV & tech checklist: 1x HDMI input, wired ethernet strongly preferred, 2x HDMI adapters, mic lav for moderator. Bring a battery pack in case power outlet is busy.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run scheduled Nov 7 09:00 PT. Auto-notify panelists 24h prior.
omar: Moderator notes: practice the 45s fallback switch, keep transitions <60s, and have the 90s clip S3 link pinned in panelist notes. Also send a DM to owners with the compact checklist.
hugo: I'll label each swag box with manifest ID and on-contact. Ship photos + weight dims by EOD tomorrow.
vivian: Final checklist: speakers & bios by Tue, manifest + weights by tomorrow, headshots by Thu, slides by Nov 1, dry run Nov 7. I'll DM owners and post a final runbook in the drive. Thanks team :raised_hands:
